svg.title: The schema, by owning module
svg.desc: The BranchBook schema: eight tables, all built in M1 by V2__schema.sql, grouped by the module that owns them. Catalogue owns five tables. branch_operating_hours, 4 constraints: branch_id and weekday form the primary key, branch_id is a foreign key, weekday is 1 to 7, opens_at is before closes_at. services, 6 constraints: id primary key, code unique and [A-Z]{2,12}, duration_minutes 15 to 120 in steps of 15, documents_needed 1 to 8. branches, 6 constraints: id primary key, code unique and [A-Z]{2,8}, name, sms_name, timezone, active and open_on_public_holidays. branch_services, 4 constraints: branch_id and service_id form the primary key and are foreign keys, capacity 1 to 20. public_holidays, 2 constraints: holiday_date primary key, name, source SCHEDULE_1 or PROCLAMATION; a note says it has no foreign key and that observed Mondays are derived in PublicHolidayCalendar. Notification owns notification_messages; the table is built in M1, each booking writes its PENDING confirmation row from M3, and the dispatcher sends it from M5. 11 constraints: id primary key, appointment_id foreign key, kind CONFIRMATION or CANCELLATION, channel SMS or EMAIL, status PENDING, SENT or FAILED, attempts 0 to 5, next_attempt_at and failure_reason. Booking owns two tables, built in M1 and written by the booking transaction from M3. appointments, 15 constraints: id primary key, reference unique in the form APT-XXXX-XXXX, status and version, the foreign key (branch_id, service_id), seat_no 1 to 20, starts_at before ends_at, customer_first_name, customer_last_name and customer_mobile starting +27. idempotency_keys, 6 constraints: key primary key, request_hash 64 hex characters, appointment_id a nullable foreign key, response_status NULL or 201, expires_at. Relationships, one to many unless stated: branches to branch_operating_hours; services to branch_services; branches to branch_services; branch_services to appointments, the main path, through the composite foreign key appointments_branch_service_fkey; appointments to notification_messages; and many idempotency_keys to zero or one appointment, nullable until the booking commits. The highlighted note, joined to appointments: appointments_seat_no_overlap is EXCLUDE USING gist with branch_id, service_id and seat_no equal and tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)') overlapping; appointments_customer_no_overlap is customer_mobile equal and the same range overlapping; both apply only WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN'), so a cancelled appointment frees its seat. Its timeline for seat 1, 09:00 to 10:00: 09:00 to 09:30 is accepted; 09:30 to 10:00 is accepted, because ranges are half-open; 09:15 to 09:45 is rejected with SQLSTATE 23P01. Footer: all eight tables are built (M1); 54 named constraints, that is 8 primary keys, 3 unique, 35 checks, 6 foreign keys and 2 exclusion; SchemaConstraintIT proves each with raw SQL, and everyNamedConstraintHasACase fails if one is added without a case. Flyway: V1 btree_gist, V2 schema, V3 reference data, V4 public holidays 2026 and 2027. Legend: built, main path, refused or not allowed, and the relationship ends: a bar is one, a crow's foot is many, a circle and a bar is zero or one.
